findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks existing service callers
findings.body: This change removes the public `findMany` method and replaces it with `getBaseConditions`, but does not provide a query method with the old contract. Any callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` will now fail to compile or run, and callers cannot use the service to execute the filtered, authorization-scoped query as before. Preserve a compatible `findMany` API or update all callers as part of this change.
